items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I ain’t playing Cindy Lauper tunes.

ctx.x: Jack DeJonnette talks about playing with Hornsby. Well that’s another thing. It’s that interpersonal relationship. I mean, you know, coming from different worlds, but there is still some common ground.

Yeah, I not from…I’m from that world. I not from a different world. That’s what the difference is. You know, kinda like when (excuse me) when a Miles was trying to convince me to join his band, I’m like, “Dude, I ain’t playing Cindy Lauper tunes. Especially with you. I ain’t doing that. I ain’t playing Prince tunes with you.” And, he said, “What do you have against social music?”
That’s what he said to you?
